M ∈ FaceMesh 
V, E, F = ElementSets( M )
`∂⁰`, `∂¹` = BoundaryMatrices(M) 
`∂⁰ᵀ` = `∂⁰`ᵀ

"""
import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from triangle_mesh import *


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, M):
        rhs = M.ElementSets()
        self.V = rhs[0]
        self.E = rhs[1]
        self.F = rhs[2]
        dimv_0 = M.n_vertices()
        dime_0 = M.n_edges()
        dimf_0 = M.n_faces()

        self.M = M
        _FundamentalPolygonAccessors = self.FundamentalPolygonAccessors(M)
        self.Vertices = _FundamentalPolygonAccessors.Vertices
        self.Vertices_0 = _FundamentalPolygonAccessors.Vertices_0
        self.Vertices_1 = _FundamentalPolygonAccessors.Vertices_1
        self.Vertices_2 = _FundamentalPolygonAccessors.Vertices_2
        self.Vertices_3 = _FundamentalPolygonAccessors.Vertices_3
        self.Edges = _FundamentalPolygonAccessors.Edges
        self.Edges_0 = _FundamentalPolygonAccessors.Edges_0
        self.Edges_1 = _FundamentalPolygonAccessors.Edges_1
        self.Faces = _FundamentalPolygonAccessors.Faces
        self.Faces_0 = _FundamentalPolygonAccessors.Faces_0
        self.Faces_1 = _FundamentalPolygonAccessors.Faces_1
        rhs_1 = M.BoundaryMatrices()
        self.dee0 = rhs_1[0]
        self.dee1 = rhs_1[1]
        # `∂⁰ᵀ` = `∂⁰`ᵀ
        self.dee0T = self.dee0.T
        rhs_2 = M.UnsignedBoundaryMatrices()
        self.B0 = rhs_2[0]
        self.B1 = rhs_2[1]
        # `B⁰ᵀ` = `B⁰`ᵀ
        self.B0T = self.B0.T
        # `B¹ᵀ` = `B¹`ᵀ
        self.B1T = self.B1.T

    def VertexOneRing(self, v):
        assert np.ndim(v) == 0
        assert v in self.V

        return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B0T @ indicator({v}, self.M.n_vertices()))) - {v}

    def VertexOneRing_0(self, v):
        v = frozenset(v)
        return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B0T @ indicator(v, self.M.n_vertices()))) - v

    def EdgeIndex(self, i, j):
        assert np.ndim(i) == 0
        assert np.ndim(j) == 0
        assert i in self.V
        assert j in self.V

        # eset = edgeset(NonZeros(`∂⁰ᵀ` IndicatorVector({i}))) ∩ vertexset(NonZeros(`∂⁰ᵀ` IndicatorVector({j})))
        eset = frozenset.intersection(nonzeros(self.dee0T @ indicator({i}, self.M.n_vertices())), nonzeros(self.dee0T @ indicator({j}, self.M.n_vertices())))
        return list(eset)[1-1]

    def NeighborVerticesInFace(self, f, v):
        assert np.ndim(f) == 0
        assert np.ndim(v) == 0
        assert v in self.V
        assert f in self.F

        # es = edgeset(NonZeros(`∂¹` IndicatorVector({f})))
        es = nonzeros(self.dee1 @ indicator({f}, self.M.n_faces()))

        # nes = { s for s ∈ es if `∂⁰`_v,s != 0 }
        NeighborVerticesInFaceset_1 = set()
        range = es
        for s in range:
            if(self.dee0.tocsr()[v, s] != 0):
                NeighborVerticesInFaceset_1.add(s)
        nes = NeighborVerticesInFaceset_1

        # eset1 = { e for e ∈ nes if `∂¹`_e,f `∂⁰`_v,e = -1}
        NeighborVerticesInFaceset_2 = set()
        range_1 = nes
        for e in range_1:
            if(self.dee1.tocsr()[e, f] * self.dee0.tocsr()[v, e] == -1):
                NeighborVerticesInFaceset_2.add(e)
        eset1 = NeighborVerticesInFaceset_2

        # vset1 = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` IndicatorVector(eset1))) - {v}
        vset1 = nonzeros(self.B0 @ indicator(eset1, self.M.n_edges())) - {v}

        # eset2 = { e for e ∈ nes if `∂¹`_e,f `∂⁰`_v,e = 1 }
        NeighborVerticesInFaceset_4 = set()
        range_2 = nes
        for e in range_2:
            if(self.dee1.tocsr()[e, f] * self.dee0.tocsr()[v, e] == 1):
                NeighborVerticesInFaceset_4.add(e)
        eset2 = NeighborVerticesInFaceset_4

        # vset2 = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` IndicatorVector(eset2))) - {v}
        vset2 = nonzeros(self.B0 @ indicator(eset2, self.M.n_edges())) - {v}
        return [list(vset1)[1-1],list(vset2)[1-1]]

    def NextVerticeInFace(self, f, v):
        assert np.ndim(f) == 0
        assert np.ndim(v) == 0
        assert v in self.V
        assert f in self.F

        # eset = { e for e ∈ Edges(f) if `∂¹`_e,f `∂⁰`_v,e = -1}
        NextVerticeInFaceset_0 = set()
        range_3 = self.Edges_1(f)
        for e in range_3:
            if(self.dee1.tocsr()[e, f] * self.dee0.tocsr()[v, e] == -1):
                NextVerticeInFaceset_0.add(e)
        eset = NextVerticeInFaceset_0

        # vset = Vertices(eset) - {v}
        vset = self.Vertices_1(eset) - {v}
        return list(vset)[1-1]

    def OrientedVertices(self, f):
        assert np.ndim(f) == 0
        assert f in self.F

        # vs = Vertices(f)
        vs = self.Vertices_0(f)

        rhs_3 = self.NeighborVerticesInFace(f, list(vs)[1-1])
        i = rhs_3[0]
        j = rhs_3[1]
        return [list(vs)[1-1],i,j]

    def FaceIndex(self, i, j, k):
        assert np.ndim(i) == 0
        assert np.ndim(j) == 0
        assert np.ndim(k) == 0
        assert i in self.V
        assert j in self.V
        assert k in self.V

        # ufv = `B¹ᵀ` `B⁰ᵀ`
        ufv = self.B1T @ self.B0T

        # iface = faceset(NonZeros(ufv  IndicatorVector({i})))
        iface = nonzeros(ufv @ indicator({i}, self.M.n_vertices()))

        # jface = faceset(NonZeros(ufv  IndicatorVector({j})))
        jface = nonzeros(ufv @ indicator({j}, self.M.n_vertices()))

        # kface = faceset(NonZeros(ufv IndicatorVector({k})))
        kface = nonzeros(ufv @ indicator({k}, self.M.n_vertices()))

        # fset = iface ∩ jface ∩ kface
        fset = frozenset.intersection(iface, frozenset.intersection(jface, kface))
        return list(fset)[1-1]
    class FundamentalPolygonAccessors:
        def __init__(self, M):
            rhs = M.ElementSets()
            self.V = rhs[0]
            self.E = rhs[1]
            self.F = rhs[2]
            dimv_0 = M.n_vertices()
            dime_0 = M.n_edges()
            dimf_0 = M.n_faces()
            self.M = M
            rhs_1 = M.BoundaryMatrices()
            self.dee0 = rhs_1[0]
            self.dee1 = rhs_1[1]
            rhs_2 = M.UnsignedBoundaryMatrices()
            self.B0 = rhs_2[0]
            self.B1 = rhs_2[1]
            # B0T = B0ᵀ
            self.B0T = self.B0.T
            # B1T = B1ᵀ
            self.B1T = self.B1.T
        def Vertices(self, S):
            return S[1-1]
        def Edges(self, S):
            return S[2-1]
        def Faces(self, S):
            return S[3-1]
        def Vertices_0(self, f):
            assert np.ndim(f) == 0
            assert f in self.F
            return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B1 @ indicator({f}, self.M.n_faces())))
        def Vertices_1(self, G):
            G = frozenset(G)
            return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B1 @ indicator(G, self.M.n_faces())))
        def Vertices_2(self, e):
            assert np.ndim(e) == 0
            assert e in self.E
            return nonzeros(self.B0 @ indicator({e}, self.M.n_edges()))
        def Vertices_3(self, H):
            H = frozenset(H)
            return nonzeros(self.B0 @ indicator(H, self.M.n_edges()))
        def Edges_0(self, v):
            assert np.ndim(v) == 0
            assert v in self.V
            return nonzeros(self.B0T @ indicator({v}, self.M.n_vertices()))
        def Edges_1(self, f):
            assert np.ndim(f) == 0
            assert f in self.F
            return nonzeros(self.B1 @ indicator({f}, self.M.n_faces()))
        def Faces_0(self, v):
            assert np.ndim(v) == 0
            assert v in self.V
            return nonzeros(self.B1T @ (self.B0T @ indicator({v}, self.M.n_vertices())))
        def Faces_1(self, e):
            assert np.ndim(e) == 0
            assert e in self.E
            return nonzeros(self.B1T @ indicator({e}, self.M.n_edges()))

 & \mathit{NextVerticeInFace}\left( f,v \right) & = \mathit{vset}_{ 1 }\\ & \begin{aligned}[t] \text{ where }& \\ v & ∈ V\\ f & ∈ F\\\mathit{eset} & = \{e \mid e\in \mathit{Edges}\left( f \right), ∂¹_{e, f} ∂⁰_{v, e} = -1\}\\\mathit{vset} & = \mathit{Vertices}\left( \mathit{eset} \right)-\{v\}\end{aligned}  \\
 & \mathit{OrientedVertices}\left( f \right) & = \textit{tuple}(\mathit{vs}_{ 1 },i,j)\\ & \begin{aligned}[t] \text{ where }& \\ f & ∈ F\\\mathit{vs} & = \mathit{Vertices}\left( f \right)\\i,j & = \mathit{NeighborVerticesInFace}\left( f,\mathit{vs}_{ 1 } \right)\end{aligned}  \\
 & \mathit{FaceIndex}\left( i,j,k \right) & = \mathit{fset}_{ 1 }\\ & \begin{aligned}[t] \text{ where }& \\ i,j,k & ∈ V\\\mathit{ufv} & = B¹ᵀ B⁰ᵀ\\\mathit{iface} & = \textit{faceset}(\mathit{NonZeros}(\mathit{ufv} \mathit{IndicatorVector}(\{i\})))\\\mathit{jface} & = \textit{faceset}(\mathit{NonZeros}(\mathit{ufv} \mathit{IndicatorVector}(\{j\})))\\\mathit{kface} & = \textit{faceset}(\mathit{NonZeros}(\mathit{ufv} \mathit{IndicatorVector}(\{k\})))\\\mathit{fset} & = \mathit{iface}\cap\mathit{jface}\cap\mathit{kface}\end{aligned}  \\
\end{align*}
